messages:
Avery (devex): Heads-up: onboarding sample app created duplicate users when server returned 429 + Retry-After. We set Idempotency-Key but second request lost it.
Nina (sdk): Any traces? Is the header dropped by retry logic or during token refresh?
Avery (devex): Minimal repro: initial POST with Idempotency-Key: onb-001, server returns 429 Retry-After: 1. SDK retries but Authorization rotated and custom headers map rebuilt without Idempotency-Key. Server logs show two inserts.
Rajat (eng-runtime): That matches a bug: server saw idempotency=onb-001 then idempotency=generated-xxxx. We need SDKs to preserve caller keys.
Nina (sdk): Agreed. Proposal: 1) SDK must NOT override or regenerate a user-supplied Idempotency-Key across retries. 2) Persist custom headers through token refresh. 3) Add internal x-rw-replay-id for observability. 4) Honor server Retry-After when present; otherwise use full-jitter exponential backoff (min 100ms, cap 10s). 5) Add safeReplayWindowMs config (default 120000).
Carmen (product): Duplicate accounts harm activation. Add this to onboarding reliability epic.
Avery (devex): Tests to add in sample app CI: a) token-rotation mid-retry unit test, b) e2e injecting 429+Retry-After asserting single side-effect within window, c) negative test for outside-window behavior.
Nina (sdk): I'll patch Node first (small change: merge original headers into retry headers without overwriting Idempotency-Key), then backport to Python/Go. Also add strictIdempotency option that disables retries if user supplies a key and retry would change semantics.
Rajat (eng-runtime): Server-side: ensure replay mapping honors client key and uses x-rw-replay-id to correlate. If repeat within safeReplayWindowMs, return stored result or 409 to avoid duplicate side-effects.
Avery (devex): Can we update onboarding docs/sample to show recommended pattern and how to read x-rw-replay-id in logs?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy to staging triggered for sha: bc12ef34
deploy-bot: Canary live (region-us-west-2)
Nina (sdk): Will open PRs for SDKs and sample app today; will include release notes about Retry-After precedence and safeReplayWindowMs.
Avery (devex): Thanks, will add CI checks once PRs link posted.
Carmen (product): Mark P1 for next sprint.
